Indicator 11 tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed patients with atrial fibrillation who develop severe bleeding within one year across Danish regions and health clusters, as monitored by the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]. In the 2022/23 reporting period, the national average for this adverse event was 3.2% [^src1]. Notably, no region or health cluster successfully met the established clinical standard, as the standard met metric remained at 0 (0) across all geographical areas [^src1].

When examining the leaders and trailers for the 2022/23 period, [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] recorded the highest proportion of severe bleeding cases at 4.5%, closely followed by [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] at 4.4% and [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]] at 4.2% [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest rates were observed in [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] at 2.2%, [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] at 2.4%, and both [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] and [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] at 2.5% [^src1].

Looking at trends across the three recorded periods (2020/21, 2021/22, and 2022/23), the national rate remained relatively stable, fluctuating slightly from 3.3% to 3.1% and back to 3.2% [^src1]. However, specific clusters exhibited significant volatility. [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] stands out as a major outlier; its rate plummeted from 4.2% in 2020/21 to just 1.1% in 2021/22, before surging to the second-highest national rate of 4.4% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Similarly, [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] saw a sharp increase from 2.7% in 2021/22 to 4.5% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Other areas, such as [[sundhedsklynge-nord|Sundhedsklynge Nord]], experienced a decrease from 4.4% in 2020/21 to 3.0% in 2021/22, before rising again to 3.6% in 2022/23 [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udvikler alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år, mellem regioner, sundhedsklynger og klyngeområder i Danmark for perioden 2022/23 samt tidligere år, og viser at Sundhedsklynge Fyn og Klynge VEST har de højeste andele i 2022/23.
